image_spec.view_round1: three-quarter front-left, slightly above, object centred, ~80% of frame, studio light
image_spec.negative: text, watermark, people, background scenery, transparent glass, thin wires, cables, floating parts, multiple objects

styles.aps: APS Industrial: white / light-grey enamel panels with soft chamfers, sparse honest seams, small point fasteners; one accent colour only - orange (hazard stripes, hatch frames, handrails); dark graphite steel frames, supports, hinges, cellular honeycomb radiator grilles, tanks; large dark-blue glazing in heavy frames (render opaque); warm white light strips, rare orange markers; no neon, no teal; clean manufactured sci-fi industrial design
styles.builders: Ancient alien monument: black faceted stone, stepped masses, slight 1.5-5 degree leans, thin glowing teal-white seam grooves (glyphs), nothing round except rings, no machinery, no pipes
styles.expedition: Same as APS Industrial but aged: faded grey enamel, scorch marks near engines, dents, dust, rare red emergency lamps, lights off

assets.name: Ark lander ship (S class, never flies)
assets.dimensions_m: 32 x 20 x 9, four landing legs, 2.2 m belly clearance
assets.visual_en: A squat planetary lander ark, the size of a small freighter: a wide low white enamel hull standing on four heavy landing legs with broad pads, a glazed bridge nose in a heavy dark frame, a wide belly ramp at the rear, two fold-out side wings with cellular radiator grilles and solar panels, external cargo container cassettes along the flanks, one orange airlock door, short dark engine blocks, clean manufactured sci-fi industrial design, no antennas or cables
assets.notes: Rio 07.10: a NEW special ark, not the S_P3_01 freighter; a lander silhouette, not a freighter; exterior via Hunyuan, interior (bridge with holotable, hold, bunk room, airlock) built in Blender; dead/alive states via material; round 2 add final_open.png with the belly ramp down

assets.name: Ark power lever panel
assets.visual_en: A wall-mounted industrial power switch panel: dark graphite steel frame, one large orange safety lever, three small round indicator lamps, white enamel cover plate, chunky bolts, clean manufactured look
assets.notes: interaction prop; used in the ark bridge and in dead stations

assets.name: Builders altar
assets.visual_en: A hexagonal black faceted stone altar, low and massive, with a recessed ring of thin glowing teal-white glyph grooves and a faceted central disc, ancient alien monument style, no machinery
assets.notes: interaction prop at monument foot and under the gate ring

assets.name: Portable drive core
assets.visual_en: A portable alien drive core: a black faceted stone block with one glowing seam, mounted inside a grey industrial carry frame with two orange handles
assets.notes: carried item for ship repair in the Long Fall quest

assets.name: Station section switch
assets.visual_en: An aged wall-mounted power panel in faded grey enamel with dust: a steel hand-wheel valve beside one orange safety lever, three indicator lamps, chunky bolts
assets.notes: revival interaction in the dead expedition station (ADRIFT)

assets.name: Colony Habitat module
assets.visual_en: A small planetary habitat module: a horizontal white enamel cylinder with rounded ends on a dark steel frame, an end airlock door with an orange frame, two round side windows, a rooftop HVAC box with a cellular grille, clean manufactured sci-fi industrial design
assets.notes: sits on plinth C-09; states build/alive/dead via material; door socket

assets.name: Colony Greenhouse module
assets.visual_en: A planetary greenhouse module: an arched tunnel with large dark glazed panels in white enamel frames, a small entry vestibule at one end, two water tanks along one side, orange accent trims
assets.notes: glass opaque in image; warm light inside when alive

assets.name: Colony Storage depot
assets.visual_en: A compact cargo storage module: a boxy white enamel hut with one large orange roller door, a short overhang roof, steel corner posts
assets.notes: must fit the existing SM_APS CargoCrates set inside

assets.name: Colony Floodlight mast
assets.visual_en: A tall tripod floodlight mast: telescopic grey steel pole, a head with four rectangular floodlights, a small solar panel on the back

assets.name: Colony Solar array
assets.visual_en: A ground solar array: two rows of dark panels on a tilted white steel frame with a single tracking hinge, an inverter box with a cellular grille
assets.notes: code turns it to face the sun

assets.name: Colony Comms mast
assets.visual_en: A communications mast: a lattice steel tower with a 2.5 m dish and two panel antennas at the top, an equipment cabinet at the base
assets.notes: no guy wires in the image; red marker light on top when alive

assets.name: Colony FAB fabrication garage
assets.visual_en: A planetary fabrication garage: a white enamel hangar with one large orange roll-up gate, a crane beam visible inside, a boxy fabricator unit, an exhaust stack with a cellular grille, dark steel frame
assets.notes: new module; rover must drive through the gate; round 2 add final_open.png

assets.name: Colony Landing pad
assets.visual_en: An octagonal landing pad: segmented grey plates with an orange edge marking, four corner landing lights, one small beacon post

assets.name: Colony module plinth
assets.visual_en: A square concrete-grey foundation slab with an orange rim and four anchor bolts
assets.notes: shared foundation under every surface module

assets.name: Orbital Solar wing
assets.visual_en: A foldable orbital solar wing: six dark panels on a thin white truss with a single docking hinge
assets.notes: attaches to station/HQ

assets.name: Orbital Cargo pods
assets.visual_en: A cluster of four cylindrical cargo pods on a cross-shaped steel rack, orange end caps

assets.name: Orbital Nav beacon
assets.visual_en: A short navigation beacon spire with a ring of lights and a reflector dish

assets.name: Mining outpost drilling rig
assets.visual_en: A planetary mining rig: a four-legged drilling derrick over a wellhead, a conveyor arm feeding a tall funnel-shaped ore bunker, a small operator cabin, white enamel panels with orange stripes on dark steel legs
assets.notes: infrastructure type MiningOutpost; ore piles near the bunker

assets.name: Solar collector field
assets.visual_en: A solar collector field: a 4x4 array of dark panels on a shared tracking frame with one central pylon, a transformer cabinet at the edge
assets.notes: infrastructure type SolarCollector

assets.name: Deep observatory
assets.visual_en: A deep-space observatory: a 16 m radio dish on a two-axis yoke over a square grey base building with a small optical dome beside it
assets.notes: infrastructure type DeepObservatory

assets.name: Builders monument dais
assets.visual_en: An octagonal black faceted stone dais, 30 m across, with a wide ceremonial stair on one side and a hexagonal altar at the centre; thin glowing teal-white grooves run along the edges; ancient alien monument, no machinery
assets.notes: walkable zone at the foot of the procedural monument; altar = P-02

assets.name: Launch yard
assets.visual_en: A planetary launch yard: a large octagonal launch pad with two tall white gantry towers on rails, a tank farm in a grey enclosure, a small control building with a glazed front, orange hazard stripes on the pad edge and gantry legs
assets.notes: surface shipyard for the first ship (ORIGIN tier 2)

assets.name: Orbital core module
assets.visual_en: An orbital core module: a short white enamel cylinder with four flat docking faces and orange docking frames, an end airlock, a ring of cellular radiator grilles
assets.notes: KIT CORE: generate first; keep it in frame for O-01..O-10 for consistency; four dock sockets

assets.name: Survey sensor boom
assets.visual_en: A sensor boom attachment for an orbital core module: a lattice arm with a sensor cluster and two small dishes
assets.notes: type SurveyOutpost = core + boom

assets.name: Probe bay rack
assets.visual_en: A probe launch rack attachment: an open frame holding six small probes in launch rails
assets.notes: type ProbeBay

assets.name: Gas scoop and tanks
assets.visual_en: A gas harvester attachment: a wide intake scoop and two spherical tanks in a steel cradle
assets.notes: type GasHarvester

assets.name: Refinery stack
assets.visual_en: An orbital refinery attachment: a furnace cylinder with large radiator fins and three product tanks
assets.notes: type OrbitalRefinery

assets.name: Laboratory ring
assets.visual_en: A research ring attachment: a glazed torus laboratory with two antenna dishes
assets.notes: type ResearchStation

assets.name: Habitat torus
assets.visual_en: An orbital habitat torus: a white enamel ring with a continuous window band and four spokes to the core
assets.notes: type OrbitalHabitat

assets.name: Container racks
assets.visual_en: A cargo hub attachment: open container racks holding stacked cargo containers
assets.notes: type CargoHub; containers = existing CargoCrates set

assets.name: Repair dock frame
assets.visual_en: A repair dock attachment: an open rectangular frame with gantry cranes and floodlights, large enough to hold a small ship
assets.notes: type RepairDock; an S-class ship must fit

assets.name: Supply tank cluster
assets.visual_en: A supply depot attachment: six cylindrical tanks on a cross rack
assets.notes: type SupplyDepot

assets.name: Defence turret ring
assets.visual_en: A defence platform ring with four compact turret pods
assets.notes: type DefencePlatform; no needle barrels

assets.name: Survey beacon / sensor picket
assets.visual_en: A survey beacon: a slim spire with a ring of reflectors, two small solar wings and one orange beacon light
assets.notes: types SurveyBeacon and SensorPicket

assets.name: Deep-space scanner
assets.visual_en: A deep-space scanner: a 34 m dish on a lattice frame with a radiator block behind it
assets.notes: type DeepSpaceScanner

assets.name: Administration hub
assets.visual_en: An administration hub: three core modules joined in a cross around a glazed rotunda hall
assets.notes: type AdministrationHub; reuse O-00 look

assets.name: Hyperspace relay
assets.visual_en: A hyperspace relay: an 80 m antenna ring on spokes around a core module with two solar wings
assets.notes: type HyperspaceRelay

assets.name: Jump gate (human-built)
assets.visual_en: A human-built jump gate: a 420 m ring of six white enamel segments joined by six dark steel generator pylons, orange emitter strips on the inner rim, a power core module attached to one side
assets.notes: type JumpGate; humans copied the Builders ring in steel

assets.name: Station hub ring
assets.visual_en: A station hub ring: a 120 m torus corridor with a continuous window band, four docking nodes on the outer rim
assets.notes: hero modular station part; interior built in Blender from the interior kit

assets.name: Station core spindle
assets.visual_en: A station core spindle: a vertical white enamel cylinder with a glazed rotunda hall at mid-height and a reactor block with radiator fins at the bottom

assets.name: Station dock arm
assets.visual_en: A docking arm: a straight corridor arm with two docking collars and orange airlock frames

assets.name: Station hangar
assets.visual_en: A station hangar: a boxy bay with large sliding doors, an internal crane beam and a landing deck
assets.notes: S-class ship must enter; round 2 add final_open.png

assets.name: Station corridor segment
assets.visual_en: A straight station corridor segment with window strips, white enamel panels and dark steel ribs

assets.name: Station airlock module
assets.visual_en: A cube-shaped station airlock module with an orange door frame and a small window

assets.name: Ancient ring section with human habitat
assets.visual_en: A segment of a colossal ancient orbital ring: black faceted stone exterior with glowing teal-white seams, a cut-out revealing a modern white enamel habitat section inside
assets.notes: UNDER THE RING origin; same interior kit as the station

assets.name: Expedition probe wreck
assets.visual_en: A crashed survey probe: a small cylinder with deployed panels, a bent dish, scorched grey enamel, dust
assets.notes: ADRIFT precursor trace; also POI on worlds

assets.name: Builders hull interior (reference)
assets.dimensions_m: bay 90 x 45 x 30; deck 200 x 10 x 7; bridge sphere 40
assets.visual_en: Interior of a colossal ancient alien vessel carved from black faceted stone, stepped walls, thin glowing teal-white seams tracing the floor, no pipes or machinery, cold and monumental
assets.notes: mood images only (3-4): docking bay, long deck, spherical bridge hall with a sky opening; built in Blender, not generated

assets.name: Interior kit style sheet (reference)
assets.dimensions_m: corridor 4 m modules on a 2 m grid; door 2.2 x 1.0; handrail 1.1
assets.visual_en: Interior of a clean manufactured sci-fi station: white enamel wall panels with soft chamfers, dark steel ribs and floor grating, orange door frames and handrails, warm white light strips, route signs, a small console, a bunk, a locker
assets.notes: mood images only (4): corridor, hall with columns, airlock vestibule, stair; drives the Blender interior kit for all stations

assets.name: Builders elevator entrance hall
assets.dimensions_m: 24 x 24 x 10 at the tower base
assets.visual_en: An entrance hall at the base of a colossal black stone tower: a stepped doorway, a hall with a docked elevator cabin, thin glowing seams
assets.notes: UNDER THE RING; cabin = E-02

assets.name: Builders elevator cabin
assets.visual_en: A faceted black stone elevator cabin with one glowing seam around its base and a wide window wall
assets.notes: window opaque in image

assets.name: Dyson swarm collector panel
assets.visual_en: A hexagonal solar collector panel on a central spine with radiator fins on the back, white frame
assets.notes: instanced 36 per swarm ring

assets.name: Asteroid set (5)
assets.visual_en: An irregular rocky asteroid with craters and faint metallic veins, grey-brown stone, no background
assets.notes: five distinct shapes; LODs

assets.name: POI ore outcrop
assets.visual_en: A rock ridge with exposed metallic ore veins and small crystals, grey stone
assets.notes: world anomaly MAGNETIC ANOMALY / mining site

assets.name: POI crystal field
assets.visual_en: A field of translucent pale crystal shards growing from rock in a cluster
assets.notes: world anomaly CRYSTAL FIELD; crystals opaque-ish in image

assets.name: POI thermal vents
assets.visual_en: A cluster of natural cone-shaped thermal vents with mineral crusts, no steam in the image
assets.notes: world anomaly THERMAL VENTS; steam is VFX

assets.name: Builders hull wreck edges (3)
assets.visual_en: A jagged broken edge section of black faceted stone hull, cracked and partially buried, with one dim glowing seam
assets.notes: Long Fall crash site; dress the procedural hull on the ground

assets.name: Garrison bunker
assets.visual_en: A low military garrison bunker with sloped walls, two sensor turrets and a wide gate, white enamel over dark steel
assets.notes: type Garrison

assets.name: Mass driver
assets.visual_en: A planetary mass driver: a long inclined electromagnetic rail on steel pylons rising from a loading building
assets.notes: type MassDriver

assets.name: Civic forum
assets.visual_en: A civic forum: a low wide dome with a continuous glazed ring and a colonnaded entrance gallery
assets.notes: type CivicForum

assets.name: Generation ship (EXODUS origin, Titan class)
assets.visual_en: A colossal generation ship, three kilometres long: a long lattice spine with a rotating habitat ring one third along it, a glazed bridge tower at the bow, a hangar deck with large doors under the stern, a block of four engines with huge cellular radiator fins, tanks and cargo cassettes along the spine; faded grey enamel with patches of different shades, scorch near the engines, warm window bands on the ring; aged industrial sci-fi, no cables
assets.notes: Rio 09.10: fourth origin EXODUS, after multi-galaxy generation; hundreds of thousands aboard for hundreds of generations; interior (bridge, ring street with housing and gardens, hangar) built in Blender; the ship stays in orbit as HQ/station/yard; A-00 lander goes down

assets.name: Hover vehicle (own)
assets.visual_en: A two-seat hover vehicle with a low white enamel body, two tilted ducted fans and a glazed cabin, orange trims
assets.notes: replaces ship hull P1_06; after EA

assets.name: Drone (own)
assets.visual_en: A boxy quadcopter drone with four ducted rotors, white enamel body, orange markings
assets.notes: replaces ship hull P1_05; after EA
